blocks.text: Navigating Outlook for claims processors on Mac

Claims processing involves constant data entry and email management. Using a Mac for this work requires you to be efficient with your keyboard. Most claims processors spend over a quarter of their week reading and writing emails. You can reduce this time by mastering the interface of the New Outlook for Mac.

items: Create a new email with ⌘ + N.

blocks.text: When you handle dozens of claims daily, your inbox becomes your primary workspace. Use folders to separate urgent claims from general correspondence. Create a folder by right clicking on your inbox and selecting New Folder. You can also automate this process by creating rules. Go to Tools > Rules to set up automated sorting for incoming claim documents.

Lazur helps you when you are stuck in a repetitive task or need to find a specific setting. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask Lazur where a button is or how to perform a task. It does not click for you, but it points at the screen so you know exactly where to look.
If you are struggling with a specific menu path, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to point it out. It will draw a circle around the menu item for you.
blocks.title: Find menus quickly

blocks.text: Common mistakes in Outlook for Mac

Many users try to find old legacy features that no longer exist in the New Outlook. The interface has moved many settings to a simplified pane. If you cannot find a feature, check the Outlook menu in the top bar to see if you are in the New or Legacy experience. Legacy support is ending in October 2026, so it is best to get comfortable with the new version now.

You can customize your keyboard shortcuts to match your workflow. Go to System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > App Shortcuts. Add Outlook to the list and enter the exact name of the menu command you want to trigger. This is helpful for actions you perform hundreds of times a day, like moving emails to specific claim folders.

Claims processors often deal with large attachments. Instead of downloading every file, use the preview feature by pressing the Space bar on a selected attachment. This lets you view the contents without opening a separate app. If you need to search for a specific document, use the search bar at the top of the app and apply filters to narrow down your results by date or sender.

Accuracy in documentation is the backbone of claims processing. When you draft an email, take a moment to review the details before hitting send. If you find yourself typing the same phrases, consider using the dictation feature in Lazur. Hold fn to start dictating and your words will appear at the cursor. This is a great way to record notes from a phone call while they are still fresh in your mind.

faq.question: Can I use the Legacy Outlook for Mac in 2026?
faq.answer: Support for Legacy Outlook for Mac with Exchange Online mailboxes is scheduled to end in October 2026. You should transition to the New Outlook for Mac to avoid service interruptions.

faq.question: Does Lazur click buttons in Outlook for me?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not click buttons or operate apps for you. It points at the screen to show you where buttons are located or guides you through a process one step at a time.

faq.question: How do I find a missing setting in Outlook for Mac?
faq.answer: If you cannot find a setting, you can hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to point it out. It will highlight the location on your screen.

faq.question: Is Outlook for Mac compatible with all insurance software?
faq.answer: Compatibility depends on your specific claims management system. Check with your IT department to ensure your enterprise software supports the current version of Outlook for Mac.
